## File: facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/augmentor.py

Prompts

```
['create an AdjustGamma callable that applies random gamma and gain to a PIL image sample', 'create a SequenceDispFlowAugmentor with crop_size and optional scale, flip, saturation, and gamma params', 'run color_transform on a sequence of stereo image pairs with symmetric or asymmetric photometric augmentation', 'run eraser_transform on a sequence of stereo image pairs to randomly occlude regions with mean color', 'run spatial_transform on image and disparity pairs to apply random scaling, stretching, and cropping', 'create a DynamicReplicaDataset instance to load stereo image sequences with depth and mask annotations from a data root', 'create a SequenceSceneFlowDataset to load FlyingThings3D, Monkaa, or Driving stereo image and disparity pairs for training', 'create a SequenceSintelStereo dataset to load Sintel stereo training sequences with sparse disparity ground truth', 'fetch a PyTorch DataLoader combining SceneFlow and DynamicReplica datasets with configurable augmentation and batch size', 'load a 16-bit big-endian PNG depth map and convert it to a float32 numpy array using StereoSequenceDataset', 'read a .flo optical flow file in Middlebury format and return a numpy array', 'read a PFM file and return the image data as a numpy array with proper endianness', 'read a Sintel Stereo disparity PNG file and return disparity values with a validity mask', 'read a Middlebury ground truth disparity PFM file and return disparity with non-occlusion mask', 'read image, flow, or PFM files by extension and return the appropriate numpy array or PIL Image']
```

```

```

facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.create_adjustgamma_augmentation: create an AdjustGamma callable that applies random gamma and gain to a PIL image sample
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.create_sequence_augmentor: create a SequenceDispFlowAugmentor with crop_size and optional scale, flip, saturation, and gamma params
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.run_color_transform: run color_transform on a sequence of stereo image pairs with symmetric or asymmetric photometric augmentation
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.run_eraser_transform: run eraser_transform on a sequence of stereo image pairs to randomly occlude regions with mean color
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.run_spatial_transform: run spatial_transform on image and disparity pairs to apply random scaling, stretching, and cropping

facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.create_dynamic_replica_dataset: create a DynamicReplicaDataset instance to load stereo image sequences with depth and mask annotations from a data root
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.create_sceneflow_dataset: create a SequenceSceneFlowDataset to load FlyingThings3D, Monkaa, or Driving stereo image and disparity pairs for training
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.create_sintel_stereo_dataset: create a SequenceSintelStereo dataset to load Sintel stereo training sequences with sparse disparity ground truth
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.fetch_dataloader: fetch a PyTorch DataLoader combining SceneFlow and DynamicReplica datasets with configurable augmentation and batch size
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.load_16bit_depth_png: load a 16-bit big-endian PNG depth map and convert it to a float32 numpy array using StereoSequenceDataset

facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.read_flow_middlebury: read a .flo optical flow file in Middlebury format and return a numpy array
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.read_pfm_file: read a PFM file and return the image data as a numpy array with proper endianness
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.read_disparity_sintel_stereo: read a Sintel Stereo disparity PNG file and return disparity values with a validity mask
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.read_disparity_middlebury: read a Middlebury ground truth disparity PFM file and return disparity with non-occlusion mask
facebookresearch_dynamicstereo/datasets/.read_generic_file: read image, flow, or PFM files by extension and return the appropriate numpy array or PIL Image
